About TerraCore

Builders in Northern Mindanao often send samples to labs far away, which means delays and extra cost. TerraCore brings materials testing closer to the job site.

Our mission

To give contractors, engineers, and government offices fast, accurate, standards-based test results that keep construction safe.

Our vision

To be the trusted local materials testing laboratory for infrastructure across Northern Mindanao.

Services Offered


Sieve Analysis (Soil Testing)

Determines the particle size distribution of soil to classify its composition and assess its suitability as a stable foundation for construction projects.

Concrete Testing (Cylinder Compression & Core Testing)

Evaluates the compressive strength and durability of hardened concrete cylinders and extracted core samples to verify compliance with structural design specifications and Philippine standards.

Aggregate Gradation & Field Services (Field Density Testing)

Assesses aggregate particle sizes and measures in-place soil compaction directly on-site to ensure a solid, reliable base for roads, bridges, and building structures.
